scope: Static analysis of the official macOS arm64 ChatGPT package. No app execution, sign-in, user sessions, or dynamic behavior verification.

implementation.pip_ui: Objective-C/AppKit native classes PIPStackController, PIPStackWindow, PIPStackContentView, PIPStackItem, PIPStackItemCompletionEffect in sky.node; Core Animation layers and native filters.
implementation.bridge: Electron main JavaScript invokes sky.node. AppKit host can register a native window handle, anchor rectangles, thread/pet placement and interaction passthrough rectangles.
implementation.computer_content: Remote-hosted native presentation via CAContext/CALayerHost and an XPC content producer; native service is SkyComputerUseService. Encoded-video delivery to renderer is a separate opt-in subscription path.
implementation.browser_content: MCP tool-completion screenshot metadata supplies data:image URL, decoded to NSImage/CGImage and displayed as CALayer image. This is not a live WebContentsView moved into PiP.
implementation.runtime_limit: Linux cannot execute or visually validate the macOS AppKit/QuartzCore implementation. A Linux browser preview can reproduce observed appearance and recovered timing, but cannot establish native 1:1 fidelity.

panel.note: PIPStackWindow creates two panels and two PIPStackContentViews, then follows owner window. Normal-level construction does not imply a conventional always-on-top Electron window.

image_geometry.note: Image corner radius belongs to Browser Use image path. Remote-hosted computer window shape can differ and must not be inferred from this value.

appearance.note: Use the native spring, not an arbitrarily chosen CSS duration.

stack.limit_source: PIPStackController visibleStackItemLimit 0x1f328, constant NSNumber integer=5 at 0xa4848
stack.alignment_note: Six anchor alignment values influence centering, signs, and fixed edge. Do not reduce to generic free-floating absolute position.
stack.nonlead_distance_formula: k=baseK/(1+0.18*d); c=baseC/(1+0.08*d); d=abs(itemIndex-leadIndex), or d*=1+0.45*d for programmatic moves

interaction.click: On endDrag, if leader is already first item and hasMoved is false, invoke presentation click handler. Then promote selected item and move stack to nearest anchor using drag velocity.
interaction.resize: Change maxDisplaySize using vertical pointer delta, sign determined by alignment, clamp 100..400, snap to backing scale. Ignore changes smaller than0.5pt.
interaction.browser_focus: Native click focuses actual IAB or matching Chrome extension tab. No direct page input in the image PiP is established by this path.
interaction.computer_focus: Native producer focus/interaction action, separate from browser tab focus. Exact takeover protocol is not established merely from these UI handlers.

fling.cross_host_eligibility: projected point lies in candidate host anchorFrame expanded by120pt

resize_handles.location: Inside all four corners of each visible item

resize_anchor_lifecycle.stack_alignment: Original stack alignment retained in currentTargetAnchor; never replaced by opposite hit-corner alignment
resize_anchor_lifecycle.fixed_point: Selected item motion origin + resizeFixedLocalPoint(size,hitAlignment), snapped to backing scale
resize_anchor_lifecycle.center_exception: When original stack alignment4/5, use that center edge in fixedLocalPoint instead of corner-hit alignment
resize_anchor_lifecycle.release: Clear resizeInteraction/fixed-point lock, recompute original rest offsets, use idle springs to settle toward original currentTargetAnchor. No nearestTargetAnchor call and no adoption of hit-corner alignment. Center alignment4/5 skips this release reconciliation. Pending host-change layout can be processed separately after release.

resize_cursor.macos_15_plus: NSCursor frameResizeCursorFromPosition:inDirections:, raw position12 for diagonal0 and6 for diagonal1, direction3
resize_cursor.older_fallback: Custom diagonal symbol cursor images, hotSpot(12,12)

browser_state.cleanup: sessionEnded, no open tabs, removed tab IDs, turn/completed, thread/archived, thread/closed, thread/deleted
browser_state.activity: Per-thread reference count of active browser sessions. First session activates; last session removal deactivates.
browser_state.native_invalidate: invalidateBrowserPresentationWithID directly removes image presentation, including on turn completion; it does not use the computer/XPC completed-invalidation deferral.
browser_state.focus_targets: Only iab gets tab/session mapping; chrome gets mapping only when extensionInstanceId exists. cdp/mcpapps previews have no mapped native browser-focus callback in Xre.

computer_completion_state.main_entry: completeTurn({threadId,turnId},status): completed calls completeRemoteHostedPIPContentThread; other status calls invalidateRemoteHostedPIPContentTurn
computer_completion_state.native_complete: Marks each not-yet-completed presentation completed and calls showCompletionEffectWithApplicationIcon.
computer_completion_state.invalidation: XPC invalidatePresentationWithID:withReply queues reply while presentation.completed; it does not immediately remove the completed preview.
computer_completion_state.ordering_limit: Browser tool-completion handler and renderer completeTurn IPC are different paths. Their runtime ordering was not executed or established.

screenshot_measurements_only.note: Screenshot does not disclose device scale, version, browser/computer backend, timing, hover controls, or input semantics. These are raster measurements, never recovered CSS values.

anchors.coordinate_system: Native screen coordinates, y increases upward
anchors.host_defaults: Only four corners at24pt inset. Explicit host anchors replace fallback and can include center alignments.

hover.applies_to: Native generic PIPStackItem path, both browser images and computer remote-hosted content. React sidebar browser gating is separate.
hover.additional_monitors: Local and global NSEvent mouseMoved mask32; attached only while view has window
hover.entered_or_moved: Convert event locationInWindow to content point, updateHoverAtContentPoint, then updateCursorAtContentPoint.
hover.exited: Restore arrow unless resizing, then recompute actual current mouse location; do not blindly clear between native content/control panels.
hover.refresh: refreshCursorState invalidates cursor rects and recomputes hover in BOTH content views after motion frames. Attaching a view installs monitors/refreshes; detaching ends active resize, removes monitors, clears hover.
update_algorithm: If resizeInteraction exists, return without recalculating.
Pick presentation using highest zIndex among visible, non-exiting item current-frame rectangles.
Set control reveal target1 if item hit OR pointer inside controlsHoverFrame while controlsVisible; otherwise0.
If pointer intersects resize handle, clear hovered control; otherwise use controlIdentifierAtPoint.
Clear previous item hover, set new item hover.
hover.clear: Set reveal0; clear hovered control and hovered item.
hover.control_hit_test: Requires controlsVisible=true and revealProgress>0.001, specific button layer not hidden, and pointer in its true button rectangle.
hover.view_hit_test: Reject host interactionPassthroughFrame first; accept resize handle OR item OR visible control; otherwise pass through.
hover.drag: Beginning drag clears hovered-control highlight but retains selected item hover. There is no forced control hide in reveal/visibility methods.
hover.resize: Resize has priority over control press; beginResize cancels drag/programmatic move, clears control hover, retains resizing-item hover. Hover updates are suspended until resize completes.
hover.button_press: Store hit identifier and start point. Motion>=4pt cancels pending button and starts drag at original point. MouseUp fires action only if release hit identifier equals stored identifier.
hover.controls_above_item: aboveItem=(visibleStackItemCount>1). With multiple items, controls geometry uses the item whose current frame has greatest maxY, rather than blindly first item.
hover.controls_docked: docked=!expandedMotionEnvelope argument; expanded describes drag/resize/motion/settling envelope, not hover enlargement.
hover.controls_hover_frame: Union of visible button rectangles expanded18pt horizontally and10pt vertically, equal to fogShape. Above-item buttons have2pt gap; expanded region overlaps item by8pt. Extra22pt backdrop expansion is not hit/reveal region.

field_separation.layout_visible: controlsVisible ivar offset506; independent of reveal/opacity
field_separation.reveal_target: controlRevealProgress ivar offset576, stored immediately before opacity animation
field_separation.presentation_opacity: Animated CALayer presentation opacity, used for visual retargeting but not native control hit-test
field_separation.reveal_region: updateHover checks controlsVisible only for controlsHoverFrame, so pointer may reveal controls from hover region while current alpha and target are0
field_separation.click_gate: controlsVisible && storedRevealTarget>0.001 && !buttonLayer.hidden && pointInsideButtonRect; enables immediately at target1 and disables immediately at target0 even during120ms fade
field_separation.evidence: setControlRevealProgress0x29944; controlIdentifierAtPoint0x1d7d4; updateHover0x1d690; native ivar metadata0xae280/0xae2b0

placement.visibility: Require shouldShowTask callback true and absence from suppressedThreadIDs. Scope all(1,pet) permits eligible presentations across threads; scope thread requires threadID==activeThreadID and, for home placement, codexHomeAvailable. Pinned does not require home availability.

host_following.role_split: Content and controls are two sibling NSPanel children of owner. Controls additionally ordered above content by windowNumber.
host_following.attach: Preserve both frames, detach from previous owner, add both above new owner, match owner.level, restore frames without animation, order controls above content.
host_following.missing_owner: Detach both and orderOut; never attach to either PiP panel itself.
host_following.reaction: Ignore own two panels. Reconcile current host/owner, attach, layoutForHostChangeAnimated:false. Some scope-all activation paths re-order asynchronously on main queue.
host_following.dom_video: setHiddenForDOMVideo(true) hides and detaches BOTH native panels, clears owner reference. It does not keep native controls floating over DOM video.

motion_integrator.method: Semi-implicit Euler, no substeps in recovered function
motion_integrator.first_frame: lastTimestamp initialized with CACurrentMediaTime at display link start; same elapsed clamp, no special1/60
motion_integrator.on_settled: Helper only returns boolean; caller does not snap origin to target or zero velocity in ordinary all-settled path. Small residual remains.
motion_integrator.exiting_items: Exiting motions are also stepped with same helper/dt and included in allSettled.
motion_integrator.motion_stop: No drag, no programmatic move and allSettled: clear motion flags and apply stationary envelope. Display link stops only when contrast sampling also idle.

test_vector.note: Settled retains nonzero residual and velocity.

motion_envelope.content_union: Union current rendered frames of visible/contributing active items plus exiting items.

stationary.rounding: No explicit caller backing snap, clamp or floor

motion_envelope.expanded_trigger: dragInteraction!=nil OR programmatic movement active OR !allSettled; active resize also explicitly requests expanded envelope

expanded_nonresize.size_cache: Componentwise maximum of desired size and prior expanded cached size; cannot shrink until stationary reset
expanded_nonresize.clamp: Translate to visibleScreen; never shrink dimensions
expanded_nonresize.rounding: Clamp helper snaps origin to backing scale. No explicit size rounding or final origin floor.

expanded_resize.freeze: Compute once and reuse actual applied panel.frame until resize ends
expanded_resize.fixed_point: Stored resizeFixedScreenPoint when valid; else C.center
expanded_resize.alignment: Resize fixed-corner alignment, except original centered stack4/5 overrides
expanded_resize.rounding: Snap origin and max(1,size) to backing scale; clamp origin to visibleScreen (which snaps origin again); final floor(x),floor(y). Cache actual applied panel frame.

motion_envelope.clamp_formula: x=max(screen.minX,min(x,screen.maxX-width)); y=max(screen.minY,min(y,screen.maxY-height)); dimensions unchanged. Oversized envelope resolves to screen min edges.
motion_envelope.backing_snap: roundToNearestTiesAwayFromZero(value*panel.backingScaleFactor)/panel.backingScaleFactor, ARM frinta at0x1f250. This differs from JavaScript Math.round for negative halves.
motion_envelope.window_application: Ensure width,height>=1, set both panel frames with display:false,animate:false. No extra application-code rounding at this stage.

display_link.callback_timestamp: inOutputTime.hostTime / CVGetHostClockFrequency(), not inNow and not CACurrentMediaTime per tick
display_link.seed_timestamp: CACurrentMediaTime initializes lastTimestamp at motion/display-link start
display_link.coalescing: Atomic pending false-to-true compare/exchange (CASALB acquire-release at0x258f4). If already true, drop callback; do not overwrite accepted timestamp.
display_link.delivery: Capture accepted timestamp and weak controller in dispatch_async(main).
display_link.main_callback: If weak controller resolves, release-store pending=false BEFORE checking displayLink exists and CVDisplayLinkIsRunning. Then call displayLinkDidFireAtTimestamp(capturedTimestamp).
display_link.reset: startDisplayLink and stopMotionDisplayLink also reset pending=false
display_link.keep_running: motionDisplayLinkNeedsMotion OR controlIconContrastSamplingActive. Hover alone has no third keep-alive reason.
display_link.contrast: startControlIconContrastSampling0x28e38 sets active and starts same link. stop0x28e4c clears active/requested flags and sample/color timestamps, then stopDisplayLinkIfIdle.
display_link.source_failure_behavior: Create failure logs and returns. No Timer fallback is visible in recovered native source. A replica fallback must be labeled separately.
